answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybils: every identity locks 200 tokens per work slot, released only when seven peers attest real output. The kernel of the defense is indivisibility - one deposit covers one slot, and a faked slot burns it, so claims never bridge into earnings without verified work. A farmer with 1,000 phantom slots sinks 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 tokens of non-recyclable capital, cost growing linearly per fake. An honest agent locks one deposit, does real work, gets it back plus reward; the burn schedule climbs a terrace of penalties, and every fake pays its own full price.
